purpose: Compare the frozen v10 trial clock and training-only language fits with uninstrumented process CPU on the same Cloud Run revision.
analyses: Use the v9/v10 trial's frozen instruction, MOVS and STOS weights for an offline transfer check on every complete case. Native-before and native-after are uninstrumented CPU observations. Keep CPU duration of metered execution separate.

Apply the shipped v10 reference fit separately to each complete built-in language cohort using the default weighted-work-nanoseconds-v1 method and default thresholds. Keep failed fits and every held-out algorithm.

For each workload compare the entire frozen prediction range to the full native range with a 20% margin. Seek same-language pairs whose timing gap exceeds the ratio permitted by any nonnegative instruction/MOVS/STOS coefficients. Use all repetitions and the most favorable native extremes. These retrospective witnesses assess the expressive power of the counters only.
Report incomplete collections and resource or runtime failures. No configuration or default changes follow from this experiment.
